messages:
alex: FYI customer hit huge variance in embedding 'units' when mixing 128d and 1024d in the same batch. They don't understand why similar batch sizes cost so differently.

maria: We don't surface per-request unit estimates in Console today. Only aggregate stats.

sam: We already calculate an estimate in preflight for routing. Could expose it via headers and a sampled Console panel. Need to be explicit: not billing.

julian: UX idea: show `X-Embed-Estimate-Units` and a tiny dims bucket breakdown (e.g. 128:3,1024:1). That explains mixed-dim penalties fast.

ingress-bot: Current preflight emits compact header: `X-Embed-Estimate-Units:2300` and `X-Embed-Estimate-BREAKDOWN:tokens=9200;buckets=128:3,1024:1;pad=64`

maria: Plan: add Console flag `console.embed_estimates_v1`, request details panel, and route dashboard histogram (p50/p95/p99). Tooltip: "Estimated units: guidance for batching & model selection; not an invoice."

sam: Implementation: compress large batches into dims buckets server-side to avoid O(n) cost for headers. Emit Prom metrics `ingress_embed_estimate_units_sum` and hist with labels tenant_id, route, dims_bucket.

julian: Also add a dashboard filter by dims_bucket so teams can isolate high-cost shapes. Highlight outliers.

alex: Security check: we're only sending counts and computed numbers, no payloads. OK to proceed.

maria: Rollout: internal canary next week, opt-in for customers. We'll log parse failures for DevEx triage.

sam: I'll open the ingress PR today with headers + metrics behind a flag.

julian: I'll draft the tooltip and doc snippet explaining dims buckets and common pitfalls.

alex: Action items assigned. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
